title: was the artist drunk?
text:
was the artist drunk?. I'm not sure if the artist was drunk or if the wavy lines were intentional, but wither way...it's kinda weird. I really want to say that this book would be excellent if it weren't for the drunken lines, but in my opinion, there is also a lot of unused white space as well, which annoys me.

This book is only 32 pages and doesn't have a lot of variety to the images. It would be okay as a starter colour book for those who don't have a lot of experience, but for the most part, this was a bit of a let down.

product_metadata.title: Darice 30000609 Cityscapes Theme Coloring Books for Adults
features: Colorful and glossy cover to the book
description: Darcie's cityscape themed coloring book has detailed patterns designed for adults to color in. There are 32 back to back pages to enjoy coloring. Decorate your cities with crayon, watercolor, colored pencils or markers. Add details to the windows and sky. Use the last page to write notes and test your mediums.
